name: droplet_extinction
title: Droplet model: did the visible flame go out?
target_label: test ended in Extinction (visible flame went out before the fuel was gone)
burning_label: the visible flame did not go out

dropped_features.flow_cm_s: every FLEX droplet burned in still gas: the feature is constant
dropped_features.flow_direction: not applicable to a droplet in still gas
dropped_features.gravity_g: the data span one gravity level (microgravity); the specification says to drop it

added_features.co2_pct: CO2 dilution is the suppression variable FLEX was flown to test; leaving it out would hide the experiment's main factor
added_features.he_pct: helium dilution is FLEX's second suppression variable (51 tests)

notes: y = 0 groups Disruption and Completion. A disrupted droplet is not an extinguished flame; see the sensitivity run that leaves Disruption rows out.
Grouping is by tested atmosphere because FLEX is a single investigation: a model is always scored on atmospheres it never saw.
headline_note: The worse of grouped cross-validation and the leave-one-material-out stress test.

sensitivity_without_disruption.note: Disruption rows removed; y = 1 Extinction, y = 0 Completion.
